data.entity_name: 武汉兴图新科电子股份有限公司
data.content:
武汉兴图新科电子股份有限公司
武汉兴图新科电子股份有限公司是一家中国电子股份有限公司，正在上海证券交易所科创板公开发行股票进行首次公开募股（IPO），并在其招股说明书（招股意向书）中被称为“发行人”。作为发行人，其董事、监事、高级管理人员、控股股东及实际控制人均就招股说明书及其他披露材料的真实性、准确性和完整性作出承诺。

该公司主要向国防客户提供视频指挥控制及视频预警控制系统产品，下游业务主要集中在军工行业，产品主要应用于国防指挥信息系统，以及监狱、油田等少量民用通信领域。报告期内，来自直接和间接军方最终用户的合同及收入快速增长，营业收入主要来源于军方客户。由于主营业务涉及军工，部分生产、销售和技术信息属于国家秘密，被豁免披露或作脱密处理。

在业务运营方面，该公司通过获取项目线索、开展销售项目立项、安排人员跟踪客户需求、签订合同后安排发货、按部分合同进行安装调试，并在客户验收后确认收入；其销售项目立项可能远早于中标或合同签订。同时，公司面临军品收入未完成备案确认、享受退税政策存在不确定性、收入季节性波动以及经营现金流与净利润不匹配等风险。<SEP>A company issuing an IPO prospectus (招股意向书), whose latest audit report cutoff date is June 30, 2019, and which disclosed its main financial information and operating conditions for January-September 2019.

Information Technology Industry

data.entity_name: New Technology And New Product Development Risk
data.content:
New Technology And New Product Development Risk
The risk that the company's research, development, and trial production of new technologies and products such as next-generation command and control systems and codec equipment fail to generate expected returns, adversely affecting company performance.

data.entity_name: High Industry And Customer Concentration Risk
data.content:
High Industry And Customer Concentration Risk
The risk arising from the company's high dependence on national defense customers and a concentrated customer base, reflected in high proportions of sales to defense customers and top five customers.

Codec Technology
Encoding and decoding technology central to the company's products, with international standards updated every few years and domestic standards, especially military codec standards, continuously iterating and upgrading.

International Codec Technology Standards
International standards for codec technology that are updated every few years, requiring companies to quickly develop technologies adapting to new standards.

Domestic Codec Technology Standards
Domestic standards for codec technology, including military codec technical standards, which are continuously iterated and upgraded.

Military Codec Technology Standards
A subset of domestic codec technical standards specifically for military use, subject to continuous iteration and upgrading.

National Defense Customers
The main customers of武汉兴图新科电子股份有限公司, to whom the company directly and indirectly sells video command and control, video early-warning control, and other audio-video system products.

Video Command And Control Systems
Products of武汉兴图新科电子股份有限公司, part of its audio-video system offerings to national defense customers.

Video Early-Warning Control Systems
Products of武汉兴图新科电子股份有限公司, part of its audio-video system offerings to national defense customers.

Audio-Video System Products
The category of products the company provides to national defense customers, including video command and control and video early-warning control systems.

Next-Generation Command And Control Systems
One of the company's new technology and product research, development, and trial production targets.

Codec Equipment
One of the company's new technology and product research, development, and trial production targets.

Military Industry
The industry to which the company's customers belong, characterized by high user concentration, resulting in the company's customer concentration.

China Military Industry
China's military industry, characterized by high customer concentration, leading to customer concentration among issuers primarily serving national defense clients.

Issuer
An entity whose sales to its top five customers during the reporting period were 41.8949 million yuan, 102.0822 million yuan, 160.1491 million yuan, and 44.0133 million yuan, accounting for 52.66%, 68.58%, 80.83%, and 89.72% of operating revenue respectively.

Top Five Customers
The five largest customers of the issuer, whose combined sales accounted for a high proportion of the issuer's operating revenue during the reporting period.

Defense Customers
National defense clients that form the main customer base of the issuer, contributing to its customer concentration.

Military Reform
A reform in 2016 that affected the issuer's operations.

发行人
The issuer referenced in the text, whose revenue and operating profit are subject to sensitivity analysis based on changes in procurement volume.<SEP>Refers to武汉兴图新科电子股份有限公司, the issuer of the prospectus. Its direct and indirect revenue from the military market affects its operating profit, and its revenue growth depended on military demand.

军方市场
The military market from which the issuer derives direct and indirect revenue. Changes in this market's orders and revenue cause operating profit to change.

军工行业
The military industry, which is the issuer's main downstream industry. Customer procurement planning adjustments in this industry may cause fluctuations in the issuer's revenue and operating performance.

军队用户
Military users that are direct and indirect customers of the issuer. The number of contracts and operating revenue from these users grew rapidly during the reporting period.

军队改革
Reform of the armed forces that occurred at the beginning of the reporting period, causing delays or cancellations of orders from military end users, which kept the issuer's revenue and profit at a low level that year.<SEP>Reform of the armed forces that caused military orders to be delayed or cancelled at the start of the reporting period, keeping the issuer's revenue and profit low.

国防支出
National defense expenditure, which grew year by year during the reporting period, supporting faster military informatization and the issuer's revenue growth.

军队信息化建设
Military informatization construction, whose pace gradually accelerated during the reporting period and which supported the rapid growth of the issuer's military-related contracts and revenue.

营业收入
Revenue figures of the issuer across multiple periods (2016–2019 H1), used in the sensitivity analysis table.<SEP>Operating revenue of the issuer. A 1% increase or decrease in operating revenue causes a corresponding change in operating profit, as shown in the sensitivity table.

营业利润
Operating profit figures of the issuer across multiple periods (2016–2019 H1), analyzed for sensitivity to revenue changes.<SEP>Operating profit of the issuer. It changes when military market revenue changes by 1%, and it is affected by changes in operating revenue.

军品销售额变动率
The rate of change in military product sales, used in the sensitivity analysis showing the impact on operating profit across 2016, 2017, 2018, and January-June 2019.

营业收入变动率
A 1% increase or decrease in revenue used to measure the resulting change in the issuer's operating profit.

采购量
Procurement volume, changes in which may cause fluctuations in the issuer's revenue and operating performance.

Accounts Receivable
A financial asset of the company whose book value at each period-end was 91.0726 million yuan, 114.8528 million yuan, 185.9778 million yuan and 131.2506 million yuan respectively, accounting for 114.48%, 77.16%, 93.86% and 267.55% of operating revenue for the corresponding periods.<SEP>A financial item of the issuer whose scale may keep growing as business scale grows rapidly; if it cannot be collected on time or at all, the company faces bad debt loss risk.

Company
A company whose military customers or overall units serving the military, affected by the national defense and military budget management system, have long settlement cycles, resulting in high accounts receivable balances and low accounts receivable turnover ratios at each period-end during the reporting period.<SEP>The entity whose January-September 2019 financial results are reported in the input text.

Military Customers
Customers of the company that are military forces or units serving the military, whose long settlement cycles lead to high accounts receivable balances for the company.

The company's main business, which is military-related; parts of its production, sales, and technical information are state secrets.

State Secret

军品收入备案
发行人军品收入需经主管部门备案确认的程序，报告期内受主管部门变动等影响，部分军品收入尚未经备案确认，涉及金额合计高达数亿元，影响退税优惠政策的享受。

收入季节性波动风险
